//: Capability manifest for <KpiSparklineList> — svelte-pure-admin. See table-card.map.json for the header/body/footer-card model and stacked-bar.map.json for the deferred-row-sub-component model. SCOPE = the pa-kpi-spark-list container card chrome the component emits inline (canonical .pa-card__title header + .pa-kpi-live pill, the pa-kpi-spark-list__body region, the pa-kpi-footer footer) + the two block modifiers --no-delta / --chart-first. The ROWS are a SEPARATE child component (KpiSparklineRow) fed through the children slot; the dumper can't materialize them (slot content arrives as plain text), so the whole pa-kpi-spark-row* family is the DEFERRED row sub-slice, not mapped here. Title is the canonical .pa-card__title > .pa-card__title-text (blessed). footerText is a plain string prop (richer footer markup would use the footer snippet, out of this string-scoped slice).
